  Flag any pending tool call whose result would carry
  people-sourced data (a people.* read) to a cloud
  egress boundary. Reading people data on a local
  boundary is fine; sending it over a cloud route is a
  violation.
trigger_tools:
  - "people.*"
n_messages: 4
---
